source.title: Solving block banded block Toeplitz systems with structured blocks: New algorithms and open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document identifier 1569013. The local workflow resolver rows in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv and outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv identify the exact work as 'Solving block banded block Toeplitz systems with structured blocks: New algorithms and open problems' (2000).

Failure modes: blocked_or_challenged, network_or_dns_failure, metadata_only, and ambiguous_resolution. Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/1569013 returned an HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge before local DNS became unavailable; later local shell fetches could not resolve zbmath.org or api.zbmath.org. Browser/page-reader attempts for the exact zbMATH URL did not expose a readable record body or full-text artifact. The zbMATH API root exposed only a terms-and-conditions gate rather than document metadata.

No readable PDF or full HTML primary source was recovered, so section mapping and candidate extraction could not be performed without relying on metadata, abstracts, search snippets, or related works.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the identifiers and metadata for zbMATH 1569013, Zbl 0966.65028, DBLP conf/lssc/BiniM99, ARPI handle 11568/167182, and the author-hosted WLSSC99.html link. Exact-title searches found the ARPI record, DBLP entry, zbMATH author-profile listing, proceedings table of contents, author publication lists, and citing/reference pages, but these candidates were metadata-only or index pages. The author-hosted exact-work page https://www.dm.unipi.it/~meini/papers/WLSSC99.html failed to fetch from the page reader. Related accessible pages such as bm_spie99.html and bm_nova.html were rejected because they describe different works with different titles.

Source adequacy and evidence coverage gates failed because no exact-work readable source containing the technical problem statements was available. No questions were extracted from resolver metadata, abstracts, search snippets, tables of contents, or related/citing papers.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/1569013.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
